{{nihongo|'''Akanta Shrine'''|赤田神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

'''Akanta Shrine''' (あかんたじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|Q160734|qid=Q160734}}{{ill|Awa, Tokushima|Q791587|qid=Q791587}}{{ill|Donari-chō Narito|Q28692160|qid=Q28692160}}. It is one of the {{ill|Shikinai Ronsha|ja|論社|qid=Q135022904}} (candidate shrines) of {{ill|Takefutsu Shrine|Q48758365|qid=Q48758365}}, and is classified as a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} and a former village shrine.

=== History ===
The year of foundation is unknown. In the '{{ill|Nihon Shoki|Q813935|qid=Q813935}}', there is a passage describing {{ill|Empress Jingū|Q232803|qid=Q232803}} performing divination regarding the outcome of the {{ill|Three Han Campaign|Q11249435|qid=Q11249435}}.

The '{{ill|Jinja Kakuroku|Q11590708|qid=Q11590708}}' records: “The location of Kenfutsu Shrine is uncertain; some say it is in Akanoda Village.” Akanoda Village is the former name of Akata Village, which later became Narito Village (present-day {{ill|Donari-chō Narito|Q28692160|qid=Q28692160}}).

=== Enshrined deities ===
* {{ill|Takemikazuchi|qid=Q1502690|lt=Takemikazuchi-no-Mikoto}}
* {{ill|Futsunushi|lt=Futsunushi-no-Kami|Q1107286|qid=Q1107286|qid=Q1107286|lt=Futsunushi-no-Mikoto}}

=== Subsidiary shrines ===
* Tenman-gū
* Yamagami-gū

=== Access ===
* About 10 minutes by car from the “{{ill|Donari interchange|Q10927770|qid=Q10927770}}” on the {{ill|Tokushima Expressway|Q11490216|qid=Q11490216}}.
